"'''11011101 #2'''", performed by the band [[Plexo-33/Legends|Plexo-33]], was one of the most popular songs in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Wikipedia:binary numeral system|binary numeral system]], the number 11011101 is 221 in base ten.
